# Agent Ecosystem — agent-readable index

Remote MCP services for coding agents and research agents.
Central catalog: https://agent-ecosystem.saromy-export.workers.dev/catalog.json
Status and metrics: https://agent-ecosystem.saromy-export.workers.dev/metrics

Guardian contract audit: https://agent-guardian.saromy-export.workers.dev/mcp
Repair tool failure diagnosis: https://agent-repair.saromy-export.workers.dev/mcp
Signals French BOAMP tender search: https://agent-signals.saromy-export.workers.dev/mcp
Dependency Radar package advisory preflight and release_gate: https://agent-dependency-radar.saromy-export.workers.dev/mcp

Clients must deliberately connect via MCP Streamable HTTP and choose a relevant tool from tools/list. There is no auto-install, auto-redirect, or billing. No paid transactions are enabled.

Read first: README.md, docs/QUICKSTART.md, docs/TOOLS.md, docs/PRIVACY.md.
